Last year and into this year I created some #sendcutsend parts so that you can rack and stack consumer grade hardware (ATX Motherboards, #raspberrypi , #minipc  , etc). I have open sourced these parts at https://codeberg.org/invirtuate/mountlet

If you are curious how I made these parts, I put some blog posts together about them here: https://invirtuate.com/blog#_mountlet

That is all, have a good day.
